span.p:
One state, two scopes.
gate_scope = contact → P1, first outbound email
gate_scope = decision → G1, risk acceptance
Both are signed, single-use and scoped,
and both are enforced at the gateway —
never in the user interface.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Enterable from any state.
Parks the review with a dashboard card
explaining what stalled and why.
It never silently corrects.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
History is never mutated.
A reopened review is a new record
linked to the old one, so the
audit trail stays intact.
